verses.en: Thus saith the LORD unto me, Go and get thee a linen girdle, and put it upon thy loins, and put it not in water.
verses.pt: Assim me disse o Senhor: Vai, e compra-te um cinto de linho, e põe-no sobre os teus lombos, mas não o metas na água.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said to me, “Go, and buy yourself a linen belt, and put it on your waist, and don’t put it in water.”
verses.en_bbe: This is what the Lord said to me: Go and get yourself a linen band and put it round you and do not put it in water.

verses.en: So I got a girdle according to the word of the LORD, and put it on my loins.
verses.pt: E comprei o cinto, conforme a palavra do Senhor, e o pus sobre os meus lombos.
verses.en_web: So I bought a belt according to Yahweh’s word, and put it on my waist.
verses.en_bbe: So, as the Lord said, I got a band for a price and put it round my body.

verses.en: And the word of the LORD came unto me the second time, saying,
verses.pt: Então me veio a palavra do Senhor pela segunda vez, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Yahweh’s word came to me the second time, saying,
verses.en_bbe: And the word of the Lord came to me a second time, saying,

verses.en: Take the girdle that thou hast got, which is upon thy loins, and arise, go to Euphrates, and hide it there in a hole of the rock.
verses.pt: Toma o cinto que compraste e que trazes sobre os teus lombos, e levanta-te, vai ao Eufrates, e esconde-o ali na fenda duma rocha.
verses.en_web: “Take the belt that you have bought, which is on your waist, and arise, go to the Euphrates, and hide it there in a cleft of the rock.”
verses.en_bbe: Take the band which you got for a price, which is round your body, and go to Parah and put it in a secret place there in a hole of the rock.

verses.en: So I went, and hid it by Euphrates, as the LORD commanded me.
verses.pt: Fui, pois, e escondi-o junto ao Eufrates, como o Senhor me havia ordenado.
verses.en_web: So I went, and hid it by the Euphrates, as Yahweh commanded me.
verses.en_bbe: So I went and put it in a secret place by Parah, as the Lord had said to me.

verses.en: And it came to pass after many days, that the LORD said unto me, Arise, go to Euphrates, and take the girdle from thence, which I commanded thee to hide there.
verses.pt: E passados muitos dias, me disse o Senhor: Levanta-te, vai ao Eufrates, e toma dali o cinto que te ordenei que escondesses ali.
verses.en_web: After many days, Yahweh said to me, “Arise, go to the Euphrates, and take the belt from there, which I commanded you to hide there.”
verses.en_bbe: Then after a long time, the Lord said to me, Up! go to Parah and get the band which I gave you orders to put there.

verses.en: Then I went to Euphrates, and digged, and took the girdle from the place where I had hid it: and, behold, the girdle was marred, it was profitable for nothing.
verses.pt: Então fui ao Eufrates, e cavei, e tomei o cinto do lugar onde e havia escondido; e eis que o cinto tinha apodrecido, e para nada prestava.
verses.en_web: Then I went to the Euphrates, and dug, and took the belt from the place where I had hidden it; and behold, the belt was ruined. It was profitable for nothing.
verses.en_bbe: So I went to Parah and, uncovering the hole, took the band from the place where I had put it away: and the band was damaged and of no use for anything.

verses.en: Then the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
verses.pt: Então veio a mim a palavra do Senhor, dizendo:
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,
verses.en_bbe: Then the word of the Lord came to me, saying,

verses.en: Thus saith the LORD, After this manner will I mar the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.pt: Assim diz o Senhor: Do mesmo modo farei apodrecer a soberba de Judá, e a grande soberba de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: “Yahweh says, ‘In this way I, will ruin the pride of Judah, and the great pride of Jerusalem.
verses.en_bbe: The Lord has said, In this way I will do damage to the pride of Judah and to the great pride of Jerusalem.

verses.en: This evil people, which refuse to hear my words, which walk in the imagination of their heart, and walk after other gods, to serve them, and to worship them, shall even be as this girdle, which is good for nothing.
verses.pt: Este povo maligno, que se recusa a ouvir as minhas palavras, que caminha segundo a teimosia do seu coração, e que anda após deuses alheios, para os servir, e para os adorar, será tal como este cinto, que para nada presta.
verses.en_web: This evil people, who refuse to hear my words, who walk in the stubbornness of their heart, and have gone after other gods to serve them, and to worship them, will even be as this belt, which is profitable for nothing.
verses.en_bbe: These evil people who say they will not give ear to my words, who go on in the pride of their hearts and have become servants and worshippers of other gods, will become like this band which is of no use for anything.

verses.en: For as the girdle cleaveth to the loins of a man, so have I caused to cleave unto me the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah, saith the LORD; that they might be unto me for a people, and for a name, and for a praise, and for a glory: but they would not hear.
verses.pt: Pois, assim como se liga o cinto aos lombos do homem, assim eu liguei a mim toda a casa de Israel, e toda a casa de Judá, diz o Senhor, para me serem por povo, e por nome, e por louvor, e por glória; mas não quiseram ouvir:
verses.en_web: For as the belt clings to the waist of a man, so I have caused the whole house of Israel and the whole house of Judah to cling to me,’ says Yahweh; ‘that they may be to me for a people, for a name, for praise, and for glory; but they would not hear.’
verses.en_bbe: For as a band goes tightly round a man's body, so I made all the people of Israel and all the people of Judah tightly united to me; so that they might be a people for me and a name and a praise and a glory: but they would not give ear.

verses.en: Therefore thou shalt speak unto them this word; Thus saith the LORD God of Israel, Every bottle shall be filled with wine: and they shall say unto thee, Do we not certainly know that every bottle shall be filled with wine?
verses.pt: Pelo que lhes dirás esta palavra: Assim diz o Senhor Deus de Israel: Todo o odre se encherá de vinho. E dir-te-ão: Acaso não sabemos nós muito bem que todo o odre se encherá de vinho?
verses.en_web: “Therefore you shall speak to them this word: ‘Yahweh, the God of Israel says, “Every bottle should be filled with wine.”’ They will tell you, ‘Do we not certainly know that every bottle should be filled with wine?’
verses.en_bbe: So you are to say this word to them: This is the word of the Lord, the God of Israel: Every skin bottle will be full of wine; and they will say to you, Is it not quite clear to us that every skin bottle will be full of wine?

verses.en: Then shalt thou say unto them, Thus saith the LORD, Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings that sit upon David’s throne, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.pt: Então lhes dirás: Assim diz o Senhor: Eis que eu encherei de embriaguez a todos os habitantes desta terra, mesmo aos reis que se assentam sobre o trono de Davi, e aos sacerdotes, e aos profetas, e a todos os habitantes de Jerusalém.
verses.en_web: Then tell them, ‘Yahweh says, “Behold, I will fill all the inhabitants of this land, even the kings who sit on David’s throne, the priests, the prophets, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem, with drunkenness.
verses.en_bbe: Then you are to say to them, The Lord has said, I will make all the people of this land, even the kings seated on David's seat, and the priests and the prophets and all the people of Jerusalem, overcome with strong drink.

verses.en: And I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together, saith the LORD: I will not pity, nor spare, nor have mercy, but destroy them.
verses.pt: E atirá-los-ei uns contra os outros, mesmo os pais juntamente com os filhos, diz o Senhor; não terei pena nem pouparei, nem terei deles compaixão para não os destruir.
verses.en_web: I will dash them one against another, even the fathers and the sons together,” says Yahweh: “I will not pity, spare, or have compassion, that I should not destroy them.”’”
verses.en_bbe: I will have them smashed against one another, fathers and sons together, says the Lord: I will have no pity or mercy, I will have no feeling for them to keep me from giving them to destruction.

verses.en: Hear ye, and give ear; be not proud: for the LORD hath spoken.
verses.pt: Escutai, e inclinai os ouvidos; não vos ensoberbeçais, porque o Senhor falou.
verses.en_web: Hear, and give ear. Don’t be proud, for Yahweh has spoken.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear and let your ears be open; be not lifted up: for these are the words of the Lord.

verses.en: Give glory to the LORD your God, before he cause darkness, and before your feet stumble upon the dark mountains, and, while ye look for light, he turn it into the shadow of death, and make it gross darkness.
verses.pt: Dai glória ao Senhor vosso Deus, antes que venha a escuridão e antes que tropecem vossos pés nos montes tenebrosos; antes que, esperando vós luz, ele a mude em densas trevas, e a reduza a profunda escuridão.
verses.en_web: Give glory to Yahweh your God, before he causes darkness, and before your feet stumble on the dark mountains, and, while you look for light, he turns it into the shadow of death, and makes it deep darkness.
verses.en_bbe: Give glory to the Lord your God, before he makes it dark, and before your feet are slipping on the dark mountains, and, while you are looking for a light, he makes it into deep dark, into black night.

verses.en: But if ye will not hear it, my soul shall weep in secret places for your pride; and mine eye shall weep sore, and run down with tears, because the LORD’S flock is carried away captive.
verses.pt: Mas, se não ouvirdes, a minha alma chorará em oculto, por causa da vossa soberba; e amargamente chorarão os meus olhos, e se desfarão em lágrimas, porque o rebanho do Senhor se vai levado cativo.
verses.en_web: But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock has been taken captive.
verses.en_bbe: But if you do not give ear to it, my soul will be weeping in secret for your pride; my eye will be weeping bitterly, streaming with water, because the Lord's flock has been taken away as prisoners.

verses.en: Say unto the king and to the queen, Humble yourselves, sit down: for your principalities shall come down, even the crown of your glory.
verses.pt: Dize ao rei e à rainha-mãe: Humilhai-vos, sentai-vos no chão; porque de vossas cabeças já caiu a coroa de vossa glória.
verses.en_web: Say to the king and to the queen mother, “Humble yourselves. Sit down, for your crowns have come down, even the crown of your glory.
verses.en_bbe: Say to the king and to the queen-mother, Make yourselves low, be seated on the earth: for the crown of your glory has come down from your heads.

verses.en: The cities of the south shall be shut up, and none shall open them: Judah shall be carried away captive all of it, it shall be wholly carried away captive.
verses.pt: As cidades do Negebe estão fechadas, e não há quem as abra; todo o Judá é levado cativo, sim, inteiramente cativo.
verses.en_web: The cities of the South is shut up, and there is no one to open them. Judah is carried away captive: all of it. It is wholly carried away captive.
verses.en_bbe: The towns of the south are shut up, and there is no one to make them open: Judah is taken away as prisoners; all Judah is taken away as prisoners.

verses.en: Lift up your eyes, and behold them that come from the north: where is the flock that was given thee, thy beautiful flock?
verses.pt: Levantai os vossos olhos, e vede os que vêm do norte; onde está o rebanho que se te deu, o teu lindo rebanho?
verses.en_web: Lift up your eyes, and see those who come from the north. Where is the flock that was given to you, your beautiful flock?
verses.en_bbe: Let your eyes be lifted up (O Jerusalem), and see those who are coming from the north. Where is the flock which was given to you, your beautiful flock?

verses.en: What wilt thou say when he shall punish thee? for thou hast taught them to be captains, and as chief over thee: shall not sorrows take thee, as a woman in travail?
verses.pt: Que dirás, quando ele puser sobre ti como cabeça os que ensinaste a serem teus amigos? Não te tomarão as dores, como as duma mulher que está de parto?
verses.en_web: What will you say, when he sets over you as head those whom you have yourself taught to be friends to you? Won’t sorrows take hold of you, as of a woman in travail?
verses.en_bbe: What will you say when he puts over you those whom you yourself have made your friends? will not pains take you like a woman in childbirth?

verses.en: And if thou say in thine heart, Wherefore come these things upon me? For the greatness of thine iniquity are thy skirts discovered, and thy heels made bare.
verses.pt: Se disseres no teu coração: Por que me sobrevieram estas coisas? Pela multidão das tuas iniqüidades se descobriram as tuas fraldas, e os teus calcanhares sofrem violência.
verses.en_web: If you say in your heart, “Why have these things come on me?” Your skirts are uncovered because of the greatness of your iniquity, and your heels suffer violence.
verses.en_bbe: And if you say in your heart, Why have these things come on me? because of the number of your sins, your skirts have been uncovered and violent punishment overtakes you.

verses.en: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? then may ye also do good, that are accustomed to do evil.
verses.pt: pode o etíope mudar a sua pele, ou o leopardo as suas malhas? então podereis também vós fazer o bem, habituados que estais a fazer o mal.
verses.en_web: Can the Ethiopian change his skin, or the leopard his spots? Then may you also do good, who are accustomed to do evil.
verses.en_bbe: Is it possible for the skin of the Ethiopian to be changed, or the markings on the leopard? Then it might be possible for you to do good, who have been trained to do evil.

verses.en: Therefore will I scatter them as the stubble that passeth away by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.pt: Pelo que os espalharei como o restolho que passa arrebatado pelo vento do deserto.
verses.en_web: “Therefore I will scatter them, as the stubble that passes away, by the wind of the wilderness.
verses.en_bbe: So I will send them in all directions, as dry grass is taken away by the wind of the waste land.

verses.en: This is thy lot, the portion of thy measures from me, saith the LORD; because thou hast forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.
verses.pt: Esta é a tua sorte, a porção que te é medida por mim, diz o Senhor; porque te esqueceste de mim, e confiaste em mentiras.
verses.en_web: This is your lot, the portion measured to you from me,” says Yahweh, “because you have forgotten me, and trusted in falsehood.”
verses.en_bbe: This is your fate, the part measured out to you by me, says the Lord, because you have put me out of your memory and put your faith in what is false.

verses.en: Therefore will I discover thy skirts upon thy face, that thy shame may appear.
verses.pt: Assim também eu levantarei as tuas fraldas sobre o teu rosto, e aparecerá a tua ignominia.
verses.en_web: Therefore will I also uncover your skirts on your face, and your shame will appear.
verses.en_bbe: So I will have your skirts uncovered before your face, in order that your shame may be seen.

verses.en: I have seen thine adulteries, and thy neighings, the lewdness of thy whoredom, and thine abominations on the hills in the fields. Woe unto thee, O Jerusalem! wilt thou not be made clean? when shall it once be?
verses.pt: Os teus adultérios, e os teus rinchos, e a enormidade da tua prostituição, essas abominações tuas, eu as tenho visto sobre os outeiros no campo. Ai de ti, Jerusalém! até quando não te purificarás?
verses.en_web: I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills in the field. Woe to you, Jerusalem! You will not be made clean. How long will it yet be?”
verses.en_bbe: I have seen your disgusting acts, even your false behaviour and your cries of desire and your loose ways on the hills in the field. Unhappy are you, O Jerusalem, you have no desire to be made clean; how long will you be in turning back to me?
